environment.description: Same NestJS service deployed behind pgBouncer 1.21 in transaction-mode pooling with prepared statement handling via protocol-level `deallocate all` on connection return. pgBouncer's `server_reset_query = DISCARD ALL` combined with `pool_mode = transaction` causes implicit connection multiplexing that introduces non-deterministic query scheduling latency (2-47ms jitter observed in p95). Additionally, the ECS task runs with a custom seccomp profile restricting high-resolution timer syscalls (clock_gettime with CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW is filtered to CLOCK_MONOTONIC which has reduced resolution on Graviton3 instances due to ARM generic timer configuration at 1MHz vs x86 TSC). Service mesh sidecar (Envoy 1.28) applies per-route retry budget with hedged request cancellation that masks response timing correlation.

config.runtime: Node.js 18 LTS on ECS Fargate (Graviton3 ARM64)
config.service_mesh: Envoy 1.28 sidecar with per-route hedging policy (2 attempts, 15ms timeout, cancel-on-first-response)
config.network: Multi-AZ with cross-AZ traffic via service mesh
